hw_sr_overrides.hw_sr_text: The HW shall provide a 12-bit ADC channel for the front-left wheel speed sensor with input range 0-5V and ±5% accuracy over temperature range -40C to +85C.
The HW shall implement a digital out-of-range comparator on the sampled wheel speed ADC value with low threshold 0.5V (10 km/h) and high threshold 4.5V (200 km/h), asserting fault flag within 10 ms.
